claims.claim: The Parti Quebecois won nearly 60 of 127 seats in the Quebec provincial election on October 6, 2026, short of the 64 needed for a majority.
claims.episode_span: The Parti Quebecois secured the most seats in Monday’s provincial election but fell short of a majority in the 127-seat National Assembly.
claims.source_title: Canada: Quebec separatists return to power, promise new independence referendum
claims.supporting_quote: In the Quebec's provincial election on Monday the separatist Parti Quebecois (PQ) came in the lead after promising another referendum on independence from Canada but fell short of a outright majority. The PQ, led by 49-year-old Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, was on track to win nearly 60 of the 127 seats in the National Assembly, just short of the 64 needed for a majority.

claims.claim: Quantitative trend-following hedge funds returned 15.7 percent in the first nine months of 2026 while the S&P 500 rose 11.7 percent.
claims.episode_span: Computer-driven trend-following funds posted a 15.7 percent return in the first nine months of the year, beating the S&P 500’s 11.7 percent gain.
claims.source_title: How quant funds beat the market by being 'early, contrarian and right'
claims.supporting_quote: Societe Generale's SG CTA Index — the sector's main performance benchmark, which tracks the daily net returns of major strategies including Man Group, PIMCO, AQR and Winton Capital funds — notched a 15.7% return in the nine months to the end of the third quarter. By comparison, the broad-based S&P 500 rose 11.7% over the same nine-month period.
